title: Eyes on Me
teacherMove: Use before modeling a new number idea.

title: Hocus Pocus
teacherMove: Pause until the response is complete, then begin reading.

title: Scientists Ready
teacherMove: Point to an object and ask students to prepare their eyes and ears.

title: Makinig Tayo
teacherMove: Use before storytelling, vocabulary, or oral practice.

title: Mga Historyador
teacherMove: Use when shifting into community, family, or history content.
Give a concrete action: pencils down, turn, eyes front.

title: Team Check
teacherMove: Use before giving the next group-work direction.

title: Hands on Top
teacherMove: Raise both hands; wait for hands and voices to settle.

title: Number Sense
teacherMove: Use before posing a mental-math question.

title: Word Detectives
teacherMove: Use before vocabulary, context clues, or grammar.

title: Science Signal
teacherMove: Pair with a visual or object students must inspect.

title: Wika Tayo
teacherMove: Use before sentence building or oral language practice.

title: Bayanihan Beat
teacherMove: Great for civic/community lessons and cooperative tasks.

title: Freeze Like a Statue
teacherMove: Use a playful freeze, then give the next direction.

title: 1–2–3 Check
teacherMove: Students check materials, roles, and voices.

title: Clap Copy
teacherMove: Change the pattern occasionally; wait for silence after the echo.

title: Solve It Signal
teacherMove: Excellent before word problems and multi-step reasoning.

title: Eyes, Ears, Mind
teacherMove: Use before a complex text or explanation.

title: Observe–Think
teacherMove: Hold up an image, specimen, or demonstration.

title: Salita at Diwa
teacherMove: Use before discussing meaning, context, or author’s message.

title: Lakbay Kasaysayan
teacherMove: Use to signal a story, timeline, or historical source.

title: Ready, Set… Learn!
teacherMove: Use between stations, subjects, or learning phases.

title: Team Signal
teacherMove: Use once; teams stop and look before the next instruction.

title: Waterfall
teacherMove: Use sparingly; it should end in complete silence.

title: Show Me Ready
teacher: Teacher: “Show me you’re ready for math.”
teacherMove: Make readiness observable rather than asking “Are you listening?”

title: If You Hear Me
teacher: Teacher: “If you hear me, touch your head.”
teacherMove: Move from simple actions to eyes-on-teacher.

title: Curious Minds
teacherMove: Use before a demonstration or prediction.

title: Makinig, Isipin, Sabihin
teacherMove: Builds a habit of thinking before answering.

title: Eyes on the Evidence
teacherMove: Use before maps, photos, primary sources, or charts.

title: Quiet Challenge
teacher: Teacher: “Can this class get ready in 5?”
teacherMove: Turn attention into a timed challenge without yelling.
